meta.probability_formula: probability = (2*k_recent + k_older + 1) / (2*n_recent + n_older + 2); k = papers containing the topic, n = papers; recent = 2026-27. Primary 'probability' uses BCSE302L FAT papers only (n_recent=0, n_older=11). 'probability_all_papers' uses CAT1/CAT2/FAT papers whose measured syllabus window covers the topic's module ({'CAT1': ['M1', 'M2', 'M3'], 'CAT2': ['M2', 'M3', 'M4'], 'FAT': ['M1', 'M2', 'M3', 'M4', 'M5', 'M6', 'M7']}).
meta.tag_agreement_detail: 15 questions re-read (BCSE302L-CAT1-D2-2026-2027 Q1a-Q5b, BCSE302L-CAT1-D1-2026-2027 Q1a-Q5b): text 15/15, type 11/15, bloom 12/15, scenario 13/15; pooled 36/45 = 0.80. Below the 10% target (585 rows) because of context limits; disagreements follow the AI pattern (agents tag explain/identify tasks with a narrative opener as 'scenario').

meta.fat_blueprint_observed: 10 x 10 FAT in 9 of 11; all 7 modules in 10 of 11 FATs. Typical order Q1 M1 (architecture / data independence, 11 of 11), Q2-Q3 M2 (ER/EER, mapping, relational algebra), Q3-Q4 M3 (normalization), Q5-Q6 M4 (indexing / B+ tree, query optimisation), Q7-Q8 M5-M6 (transactions, serializability, 2PL), Q9-Q10 M6-M7 (concurrency, NoSQL/CAP), with 'Q9 a or b; Q10 a or b' in 3 of 11.
